rationale:
Positives: The agent verified the user via email, looked up the correct order, checked product variant availability, accurately reported that the 4-ft glass/white variant was unavailable, and upon cancellation the tool shows the order moved to cancelled with a full refund to the same gift card—consistent with the agent’s statement. The order was in pending status, so cancellation was allowed. 

Failure: The policy requires the agent to state the exact change and obtain explicit user confirmation before any order-changing write. When the user requested cancellation, the agent executed cancel_pending_order immediately without first restating the exact order to be canceled and asking for explicit confirmation to proceed. This violates the required confirmation step. Everything else aligns with policy, but missing the pre-write confirmation means it does not meet the pass bar.
